bisectDone.description: System notification title when an automatic bisect finishes while the app is in the background.

bisectFailed.description: System notification title when an automatic bisect stops with an error while the app is in the background.

packageDone.description: System notification title when packaging a fiddle or making its installers finishes in the background.

packageFailed.description: System notification title when packaging a fiddle or making its installers fails in the background.

downloadsDone.description: System notification title when every Electron version download has finished in the background.

downloadsFailed.description: System notification title when an Electron version download fails in the background.

runDone.description: System notification title when a fiddle that ran for more than 10 seconds exits while the app is in the background.

runFailed.description: System notification title when a fiddle that ran for more than 10 seconds exits with an error while the app is in the background.

notificationBody.description: System notification body: the name of the fiddle the operation ran for. {{name}} is the fiddle's name.

recent.description: Heading of the recent fiddles category in the Windows taskbar jump list.
